formElement.label: Configuration Name:
formElement.documentation: A unique name for this Delinea Secret Server configuration.

formElement.label: Delinea Secret Server URL:
formElement.documentation: The base URL of Delinea Secret Server (e.g. https://tenant.secretservercloud.com or https://secrets.internal.corp/SecretServer).

formElement.label: OAuth2 Token URL (Optional):
formElement.documentation: Optional custom OAuth2 token URL. If omitted, the plugin automatically appends '/oauth2/token' to the Delinea Secret Server URL.

option.name: OAuth2 Client Credentials (API Client ID & Secret)

formElement.label: Credential:
formElement.documentation: Username/Password or API Client ID/Secret for Delinea Secret Server.

formElement.label: Active Directory / Local Domain:
formElement.documentation: Domain name if authenticating using Active Directory credentials (for OAuth2 password grant).

formElement.label: Verify SSL/TLS Certificate:
formElement.documentation: Verify server SSL/TLS certificates. Uncheck only for private dev environments with self-signed certs.

formElement.label: Test Connection on Save:
formElement.documentation: Attempt connection and authentication before saving configuration.
